lines.en: I call Makoto to find that she is spending her free time at school today, which seems like an incredibly {i}Makoto{/i} thing to do.
lines.zh: 我给 Makoto 打电话，发现她今天的空闲时间是在学校过的——这听起来太 {i}Makoto{/i} 了。

lines.en: But it is {i}then{/i} that I find she’s actually all by herself in the school swimming pool, so I decide to go and meet up with her so I can see her in her swimsuit- which is an incredibly {i}me{/i} thing to do.
lines.zh: 但{i}接着{/i}我发现她其实一个人在学校的游泳池里，于是我决定过去找她，好看她穿泳装的样子——这可太像{i}我{/i}了。

lines.en: As you may have guessed, I regret nothing and the trip is worth it from the moment I arrive.
lines.zh: 你大概猜到了，我一点都不后悔，从我一到那儿起，这趟就值了。

lines.en: As it turns out, Makoto is not only happy to finally be a part of an {i}actual{/i} club and not just the student council, but that it’s done wonders for her overwhelming lack of relaxation as of late.
lines.zh: 结果发现，Makoto 不只对终于成为一个{i}真正的{/i}社团成员、而不只是学生会成员感到开心，而且这对她最近极度缺乏的放松也大有裨益。

lines.en: And while I’d be happy to help her out with that whenever she wants, I do think it’s good that she finally has an outlet she can enjoy.
lines.zh: 虽然我随时都乐意在她想要的时候帮她放松，但我觉得她终于有了一个自己喜欢的出口，这很好。

lines.en: Especially since I can vicariously enjoy it {i}through{/i} her by visiting her when she’s here.
lines.zh: 尤其是我还能{i}通过{/i}来这儿看她，间接地享受它。

lines.en: Eventually, watching Makoto float directly in front of me begins to get a little awkward and I feel as if I should leave so she can actually...you know...{i}swim.{/i}
lines.zh: 最后，看着 Makoto 就这么浮在我正前方开始有点尴尬，我觉得我该走了，好让她真的……你知道的……{i}游泳{/i}。

lines.en: So, being the generous guy that I am, I let her get back to it and leave the school with the image of her ingrained into my head for use at a later time.
lines.zh: 所以，作为我这么慷慨的人，我让她继续游，带着刻进脑子里的她的样子离开了学校，留着以后用。

lines.en: And by “a later time” I likely mean tonight.
lines.zh: 而我说的「以后」，大概就是今晚。

lines.en: I am suddenly filled with many regrets for leaving in the first place.
lines.zh: 我突然为当初离开感到万分后悔。
